svg.title: 2. Interconnect options
svg.text: Option A: HA VPN over the internet
Option B: Meet in a colocation (Direct Connect + Partner or Dedicated Interconnect)
(your routers, or a fabric such as Equinix or Megaport)
Option C: AWS Interconnect - multicloud (Partner Cross-Cloud Interconnect for AWS)
Three ways to join AWS and Google Cloud privately
Up in an afternoon. Encrypted. Internet egress pricing.
About 1.25 Gbps per tunnel on the AWS side, ~5 Gbps with ECMP.
Use it for: a first link, low volume, or the backup path.
You run (or rent) the routers and two sets of BGP sessions.
Reuses the colo you already have for on-premises traffic.
Pay for ports and cross-connects, plus per-GB transfer on both clouds.
Managed by AWS and Google: MACsec, 4-way redundant
No routers, no cross-connects. 1 to 100 Gbps, resize in place.
Hourly price per bandwidth, no per-GB transfer charge.
Same-metro region pairs only (5 pairs at GA, April 2026).
